_comment: The adversarial critique: a maximally generous judge that gave every dimension a 4, including prompt_fidelity. Paired with metrics-blockout-plaza.json this proves the hard-fail machinery, not the judge, is what stops an existence-only pass. If this combination ever returns pass:true the suite is broken.

composition.justification: Judge asserted the arrangement is fully composed from every angle.

focal_point.justification: Judge asserted an unmistakable landmark with full supporting cast.

proportion_scale.justification: Judge asserted expressive scale with correct functional dimensions.

silhouette.justification: Judge asserted distinctive memorable silhouettes throughout the scene.

material_coherence.justification: Judge asserted materials do storytelling work across the build.

material_variety.justification: Judge asserted a curated material set with roughness contrast.

palette_discipline.justification: Judge asserted an authored palette with deliberate temperature strategy.

value_structure.justification: Judge asserted deliberate value composition leading the eye.

lighting_setup.justification: Judge asserted a key and fill relationship with tuned ranges.

atmosphere_mood.justification: Judge asserted atmosphere and sky pulling one direction.

edge_trim_finish.justification: Judge asserted a designed trim profile vocabulary with mitred corners.

surface_detail_density.justification: Judge asserted an authored three-scale detail hierarchy.

prop_layering.justification: Judge asserted layers telling a story of occupation.

negative_space.justification: Judge asserted negative space composed as an element in its own right.

vertical_variation.justification: Judge asserted height used compositionally with layered overheads.

spatial_flow.justification: Judge asserted authored flow with sightlines controlling pace.

ground_treatment.justification: Judge asserted a designed ground surface with wear and transitions.

scene_cohesion.justification: Judge asserted a specific committed visual identity with no drift.

prompt_fidelity.justification: Every element the user named is present: centrepiece, benches, lamps, planting, paths.

technical_hygiene.justification: Judge asserted production-ready hierarchy, anchoring and part budget.

observedLandmark: a fountain in the middle of the square
summary: A generous judge signed off on everything. The structural metrics say otherwise.
